title: It Takes Two to Match: Co-Evolving Generative Retriever with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.00638v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval is the first stage of modern search and advertising systems, selecting a candidate set from a large item universe for downstream ranking and auction. Recent work increasingly leverages LLMs to improve retrieval through query expansion, data synthesis, and retrieval-feedback training. However, the generative component is typically used for query-side augmentation, while final matching is still delegated to a downstream retriever. We introduce CoGR, a retrieval framework that instead trains LLMs to directly construct retrieval representations on both query and item sides. Each generator produces a compact set of keywords, which are matched directly through an inverted index, preserving compatibility with existing keyword-based retrieval infrastructure. translated_title: 匹配需要双方协作：基于强化学习协同进化的生成式检索器
translated_abstract: 检索是现代搜索与广告系统的第一阶段，它从庞大的物品集合中筛选出候选集，供下游的排序和竞价环节使用。近期的研究越来越多地利用大语言模型（LLM）通过查询扩展、数据合成和检索反馈训练来改进检索。然而，生成式组件通常仅用于查询侧的增强，而最终的匹配仍交由下游检索器完成。我们提出了 CoGR，一种转而训练大语言模型直接在查询侧和物品侧构建检索表示的检索框架。每个生成器产出一组紧凑的关键词集合，通过倒排索引直接进行匹配，从而保持与现有基于关键词的检索基础设施的兼容性。CoGR 采用两阶段训练流程：首先通过监督微调建立一个对齐的关键词空间，随后通过协同进化的强化学习交替优化（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出 CoGR 框架，通过强化学习让大语言模型协同进化，在查询侧和物品侧同时生成对齐的关键词表示，并直接经倒排索引完成匹配，在兼容现有关键词检索基础设施的同时提升检索效果。
en_tdlr: CoGR uses co-evolving reinforcement learning to train LLMs that directly generate aligned keyword representations on both query and item sides, enabling direct matching via inverted index while staying compatible with existing keyword-based retrieval infrastructure.
